research_notes: Blocked after official roster, first-person speeches, professional-profile search and contemporaneous union-role evidence: obtain dated academic contracts, hours and identities of cultural/large employers.
PhD scholarship and undergraduate study are not employment. Insecure does not itself mean part-time or full-time.
Public LinkedIn profile returned 999; no access bypass attempted. No defensible headline total; unknown is not zero.

Follow-up2026-10-02: primary2017/18 annual report identifies Young Workers Centre governance entry2018; added official ALP senior vice-presidency2016–2018; refined lecturer/electorate/NUW titles with host and author biographies.

Targeted university, cultural-employer and union appointment searches did not identify other employers or academic contract dates/hours. Archaeologist, Transport for NSW and counselling-profile namesakes lack identity confirmation and are not imported.2018–2021 VTHC interval in derivative biographies still needs primary boundary evidence.
